alternatives.argument: The local proof derives the normalized Gaussian transform from lem-euclidean-gaussian-fourier-transform-with-two-pi-normalization, substitutes ξ=A^{-T}k so κ=2πξ, and applies thm-poisson-summation-for-a-full-rank-lattice only to this Schwartz Gaussian. Its exact series is absolutely convergent; the ordinary lattice dual, angular frequency, and Countable Choice assumption are kept distinct.

The local proof combines the periodic erfc/r distribution, whose source is the point-charge distribution minus the periodized normalized Gaussian, with the reciprocal inverse-Laplacian series for that same Gaussian. The Gaussian periodization lemma identifies their smooth source; the mean of the real part is π/α² times total charge and is therefore zero by neutrality. Both parts are absolutely convergent by the shell lemma. Their sum is the unique mean-zero solution of thm-ewald-neutral-periodic-poisson-green-function, so its off-source value and regular finite part are independent of α. The self term follows from erfc(αr)/r=1/r−2α/√π+O(r²).

The local proof packs disjoint balls about lattice points to get a uniform O((m+1)^2) shell count. It applies erfc(s)≤e^{-s²}/(√πs) and the derivative formula to each omitted real shell, and applies |Σ_iq_ie^{-iκx_i}|≤Q to each omitted reciprocal shell. The resulting energy and force series are bounded by the finite integral-test controllers defined in lem-ewald-lattice-shell-gaussian-tail-controllers, uniformly over source positions away from collisions.
